say:5:1410103001:0.text: Allow me to explain the rest.
say:5:1410103001:0.source_cn: 剩下的由我解释吧，各位大人。

choice_prompt:6:1410103001.text: Allow me to explain the rest.
choice_prompt:6:1410103001.source_cn: 剩下的由我解释吧，各位大人。

say:7:1410103002:0.text: Magister Merlin, it's an honor to meet you. I am Evie, an envoy from <style="highlight">Savannah</style>.
say:7:1410103002:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，很荣幸见到您，我是来自<style=high...
say:7:1410103002:0.male: Magister Merlin, it's an honor to meet you. I am Evie, an envoy from <style="highlight">Savannah</style>.
say:7:1410103002:0.female: Magister Merlin, it's an honor to meet you. I am Evie, an envoy from <style="highlight">Savannah</style>.

say:9:1410103003:1.text: Someone from the royal capital, huh? What brings you to our little town? Don't tell me you've come to demand some end-of-year report from us.
say:9:1410103003:1.source_cn: 王都来的……您有何贵干？该不是突然想要我们这个偏远小镇...

say:10:1410103004:0.text: I really hope not because I've had to write more than enough of those already.
say:10:1410103004:0.source_cn: 希望不是，前阵子我可被类似麻烦事折腾个够呛。

say:11:1410103005:1.text: Sir Valen, I have no intention of burdening you. I'm here to deliver a directive from a certain person to General Hogan.
say:11:1410103005:1.source_cn: 维伦阁下，我无意为大家徒增烦恼，我此行是为了向霍根将军...
say:11:1410103005:1.male: Sir Valen, I have no intention of burdening you. I'm here to deliver a directive from a certain person to General Hogan.
say:11:1410103005:1.female: Sir Valen, I have no intention of burdening you. I'm here to deliver a directive from a certain person to General Hogan.

say:12:1410103006:1.text: General Hogan, please take a look at this—

say:15:1410103008:0.text: General, I'm sure you recognize this item, which means you must understand the gravity of the situation.
say:15:1410103008:0.source_cn: 将军，您认识此物，相信一定意识到问题的严重性了……
say:15:1410103008:0.male: General, I'm sure you recognize this item, which means you must understand the gravity of the situation.
say:15:1410103008:0.female: General, I'm sure you recognize this item, which means you must understand the gravity of the situation.

say:16:1410103009:1.text: Ah... now I know who sent you. What's going on in Savannah?
say:16:1410103009:1.source_cn: 啊……竟然是那位大人派你来的！赛凡纳究竟发生了什么？

say:17:1410103010:1.text: This concerns the safety of the Empire, so I'll get straight to the point.
say:17:1410103010:1.source_cn: 此事关乎帝国安危，我就直言了——

say:18:1410103011:0.text: Intelligence suggests that <style="highlight">a group of dwarves may be conspiring to stage a coup</style>.

say:19:1410103012:0.text: Wait a second... Is this something I'm allowed to hear?
say:19:1410103012:0.source_cn: 且慢……后续内容，是我能听的吗？

say:20:1410103013:1.text: Of course. You're a trusted subordinate of the General. Besides, with the Solitaries' intelligence network, you'd probably hear of it soon enough anyway.
say:20:1410103013:1.source_cn: 当然，您是将军信任的属下。况且，以隐士的情报网，想必再...

say:21:1410103014:0.text: Magister, my employer greatly appreciates how you handled the crisis in Whiteridge. However, the shadow over the Empire hasn't completely faded. For example...
say:21:1410103014:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，那位大人非常感谢您妥善处理了白山公国危机，但...
say:21:1410103014:0.male: Magister, my employer greatly appreciates how you handled the crisis in Whiteridge. However, the shadow over the Empire hasn't completely faded. For example...
say:21:1410103014:0.female: Magister, my employer greatly appreciates how you handled the crisis in Whiteridge. However, the shadow over the Empire hasn't completely faded. For example...

say:22:1410103015:0.text: There's a place called <style="highlight">Brimstone Village</style>, a settlement situated at the top of <style="highlight">Ironhold Bay</style>.

say:23:1410103016:0.text: Oh, I've heard of it! It's home to some seriously talented craftsmen. They've got mines that churn out the Empire's best weapons and equipment.
say:23:1410103016:0.source_cn: 我听说过，那里既有矿脉又有技艺出色的工匠，常年为耀光各...

say:24:1410103017:0.text: They outfit the Royal Guard, the Heroic Order, and the Templar Knights.
say:24:1410103017:0.source_cn: 皇室卫队、骑士团和圣堂都是他们的大客户。

say:25:1410103018:1.text: That's right. Which is why, if those dwarves were to turn traitor...
say:25:1410103018:1.source_cn: 不错，正因如此，一旦那里的矮人做出背叛之举……

say:28:1410103020:1.text: Savannah sent spies to Brimstone Village, but none of them ever came back.
say:28:1410103020:1.source_cn: 赛凡纳曾派出密探前去深岩村调查，全都有去无回。
say:28:1410103020:1.male: Savannah sent spies to Brimstone Village, but none of them ever came back.
say:28:1410103020:1.female: Savannah sent spies to Brimstone Village, but none of them ever came back.

say:29:1410103021:0.text: Even when we sent our private envoys, their efforts were constantly thwarted...
say:29:1410103021:0.source_cn: 我们公开派遣特使们前往，调查并不顺利……
say:29:1410103021:0.male: Even when we sent our private envoys, their efforts were constantly thwarted...
say:29:1410103021:0.female: Even when we sent our private envoys, their efforts were constantly thwarted...

say:30:1410103025:0.text: My employer is very concerned. If the dwarves there turn against us, it could threaten the entire Empire.
say:30:1410103025:0.source_cn: 那位大人十分忧心，一旦矮人们生出异心，将对帝国造成极大...

choice_prompt:31:1410103025.text: My employer is very concerned. If the dwarves there turn against us, it could threaten the entire Empire.
choice_prompt:31:1410103025.source_cn: 那位大人十分忧心，一旦矮人们生出异心，将对帝国造成极大的威胁。

say:32:1410103026:0.text: I'm afraid I can't say. But General Hogan, you can vouch for her character, right?
say:32:1410103026:0.source_cn: 恕我无法直说那位大人的身份。但霍根将军，您应该了解她的为人。
say:32:1410103026:0.male: I'm afraid I can't say. But General Hogan, you can vouch for her character, right?
say:32:1410103026:0.female: I'm afraid I can't say. But General Hogan, you can vouch for her character, right?

say:33:1410103027:0.text: Let me explain, my friend. Evie's employer is an old acquaintance of mine. She holds a high position, and she's someone I trust.
say:33:1410103027:0.source_cn: 老朋友，那位大人是我的故交。身份贵重，值得信任。
say:33:1410103027:0.male: Let me explain, my friend. Evie's employer is an old acquaintance of mine. She holds a high position, and she's someone I trust.
say:33:1410103027:0.female: Let me explain, my friend. Evie's employer is an old acquaintance of mine. She holds a high position, and she's someone I trust.

say:34:1410103028:1.text: Thank you for vouching for her, General.

say:35:1410103029:0.text: It was she who, despite opposition, insisted on sending you and Magister Merlin as envoys to Brimstone Village to check on their weapon production.
say:35:1410103029:0.source_cn: 此次也是那位大人力排众议，推举您与梅林大人作为特使，前...
say:35:1410103029:0.male: It was she who, despite opposition, insisted on sending you and Magister Merlin as envoys to Brimstone Village to check on their weapon production.
say:35:1410103029:0.female: It was she who, despite opposition, insisted on sending you and Magister Merlin as envoys to Brimstone Village to check on their weapon production.

say:36:1410103030:0.text: You must understand that the inspection is but a pretense. In truth, your task is to uncover irrefutable proof of the dwarves' treasonous schemes.
say:36:1410103030:0.source_cn: 您应该明白，视察只是借口，实际上，是希望您和梅林大人能...
say:36:1410103030:0.male: You must understand that the inspection is but a pretense. In truth, your task is to uncover irrefutable proof of the dwarves' treasonous schemes.
say:36:1410103030:0.female: You must understand that the inspection is but a pretense. In truth, your task is to uncover irrefutable proof of the dwarves' treasonous schemes.

say:37:1410103031:0.text: I see. It's no wonder you're bringing in someone like me when I'm on the verge of retirement.
say:37:1410103031:0.source_cn: 原来如此，怪不得要用上我这个快退休之人。

say:38:1410103032:0.text: This isn't just any mission, General. It's a request based on trust and friendship. Will you accept?
say:38:1410103032:0.source_cn: 这不是简单的任务，更是基于信赖和友谊的嘱托。您愿意接受吗？

say:39:1410103033:0.text: Well, if I can be of help, why not? Besides, if your employer requested this, I don't really have a choice.
say:39:1410103033:0.source_cn: 能用得上我，何乐不为？更何况，这是那位大人的意思，我责...

say:40:1410103034:0.text: But... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, old friend, what's your take on this?
say:40:1410103034:0.male: But... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, old friend, what's your take on this?
say:40:1410103034:0.female: But... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, old friend, what's your take on this?

choice_prompt:41:1410103034.text: But... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, old friend, what's your take on this?
choice_prompt:41:1410103034.male: But... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, old friend, what's your take on this?
choice_prompt:41:1410103034.female: But... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, old friend, what's your take on this?

say:42:1410103035:0.text: I must sound like a broken record, thanking you each time. But I truly appreciate it.
say:42:1410103035:0.source_cn: 我嘴里的谢谢，你一定听腻了。真不知道怎么感激你。
say:42:1410103035:0.male: I must sound like a broken record, thanking you each time. But I truly appreciate it.
say:42:1410103035:0.female: I must sound like a broken record, thanking you each time. But I truly appreciate it.

say:43:1410103037:1.text: Now, I've already arranged a ship. You can depart whenever you're set.
say:43:1410103037:1.source_cn: 二位，其实我已经安排好船只了，随时可以出发。

say:45:1410103038:0.text: Valen, I'm leaving Holistone in your hands. Don't forget my orders.
say:45:1410103038:0.source_cn: 维伦，圣石镇就交给你了，另外，别忘了我的嘱托。

say:46:1410103039:0.text: Of course, of course! With something this important, I won't be slacking off.
say:46:1410103039:0.source_cn: 是是，这么大的事情，我绝对不会怠慢的。

say:47:1410103040:0.text: Good. If a single stone is missing from town, you'll be the one answering for it.
say:47:1410103040:0.source_cn: 你小心点，要是镇上少了一块石头，唯你是问！

say:48:1410103041:1.text: Don't worry, General! I'll keep the town safe. Have a safe journey!
say:48:1410103041:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我会一边保护镇子，一边祝愿二位平安归来的。

say:49:1410103042:0.text: Take care, General... and you as well, <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:49:1410103042:0.male: Take care, General... and you as well, <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:49:1410103042:0.female: Take care, General... and you as well, <style="stress"><player_name></style>...

say:51:1410103036:0.text: As expected from Magister Merlin. With your brilliance, you'll be the one to shine a light on all this mystery.
say:51:1410103036:0.source_cn: 不愧是梅林大人，您作为伟大的魔法师，有着一颗如此光明的...
say:51:1410103036:0.male: As expected from Magister Merlin. With your brilliance, you'll be the one to shine a light on all this mystery.
say:51:1410103036:0.female: As expected from Magister Merlin. With your brilliance, you'll be the one to shine a light on all this mystery.

choice:41:1:2.text: I'll do it to find the truth.
choice:41:1:2.male: I'll do it to find the truth.
choice:41:1:2.female: I'll do it to find the truth.

say:52:1410103022:0.text: Oh, Magister, I know you've got a soft spot for the dwarves.
say:52:1410103022:0.source_cn: 梅林大人很讲义气，有不少矮人朋友。
say:52:1410103022:0.male: Oh, Magister, I know you've got a soft spot for the dwarves.
say:52:1410103022:0.female: Oh, Magister, I know you've got a soft spot for the dwarves.

say:53:1410103023:1.text: I understand. I've got plenty of dwarven friends too. They're honest, hardworking, and so passionate about their craft. They'd never betray us.
say:53:1410103023:1.source_cn: 我能理解，我也有认识许多矮人，他们憨厚老实，一门心思地...

say:54:1410103024:1.text: But the dwarves we know aren't the same as those in Brimstone Village.
say:54:1410103024:1.source_cn: 可是，这份信任，终究只能给予我们所熟悉的矮人，而非深岩...

narration:55:14010112:0.text: While you all are talking, a young woman shows up and greets you with a polite bow.
narration:55:14010112:0.source_cn: 你们正在说话之时，一位年轻的女性出场并行了一礼。
